A weighing goes straight to a profile when only that profile\'s last weight is this close. Otherwise the app asks whose it is. A smaller value asks more often; a larger one may pick the wrong person when weights in the family are close.
The weight card always comes first. An indicator by one formula can sit next to the same indicator by the formula chosen below, to compare them.

Which published equation each indicator uses. Changing it recalculates the whole history. Fat-free mass by impedance gives body fat when the scale measures impedance. When an equation has no data for a weighing, for example no impedance, the next one in the list is used.

Weighings take these values, so they are not typed each time; past weighings keep their own. Measure in the morning, standing relaxed, after a normal breath out, with the tape snug but not pressing. Waist: midway between the lowest rib and the top of the hip bone. Hips: around the widest part of the buttocks. Neck: just below the larynx.

Weighings take these values, so they are not typed each time; past weighings keep their own. Measure in the morning, standing relaxed, after a normal breath out, with the tape snug but not pressing. Waist: midway between the lowest rib and the top of the hip bone, not at the belt line. Neck: just below the Adam\'s apple, the tape sloping slightly down to the front. Hips: around the widest part of the buttocks; for men they give only the waist-to-hip ratio.

Weighings take these values, so they are not typed each time; past weighings keep their own. Measure in the morning, standing relaxed, after a normal breath out, with the tape snug but not pressing. Waist: midway between the lowest rib and the top of the hip bone. Hips: around the widest part of the buttocks, feet together. Neck: just below the larynx, the tape sloping slightly down to the front. Waist, hips and neck together give body fat by the US Navy method.

resources.string: As in the profile on the main screen
From the phone, on every connection. Weighings kept in the scale memory carry its time.

The scale is told every checked profile and tells them apart by weight; when the weight fits several people, it asks who is on it. Weighings kept in its memory are read after the first weighing of a connection, not on connecting alone. Records from before the scale was added go to the inbox.

The scale is told the profile chosen on the main screen if it is checked, otherwise the first checked one. If someone else steps on it, body fat on the scale display is worked out for the wrong person; the app works out body composition itself, for the profile the weighing goes to.
